# P2PxBT

> A peer-to-peer cryptocurrency marketplace covering the United States, United
> Kingdom, Europe and Hong Kong. Buyers are matched with counterparties who
> quote their own spread over a live reference price; payment details are
> issued by an operator in the trade chat rather than published on a listing,
> and identity verification is required before a first trade.

Assets traded: BTC, ETH, SOL, USDT. Payment rails: USA Bank Wire, ACH Transfer,
UK Faster Payments, SEPA Transfer, FPS Transfer (Hong Kong), Bank Transfer.

Pricing is derived from a live reference feed: sellers quote a 4.00%–6.00%
premium over mid, buyers a 2.00%–4.00% discount under it. Each counterparty's
spread is fixed, so listings compete on price.

## Core

- [Home](https://p2pxbt.com/): marketplace overview and live reference prices
- [Marketplace](https://p2pxbt.com/marketplace): live offers across all four assets and markets
- [How it works](https://p2pxbt.com/how-it-works): the trade lifecycle from verification to completion
- [Fees](https://p2pxbt.com/fees): what a trade costs and how spreads are set

- [Best Escrow Services for Crypto Trading in 2024](https://p2pxbt.com/blog/best-escrow-for-crypto): Compare the top crypto escrow services and learn what makes a great escrow platform for safe P2P cryptocurrency trading
- [How P2P Pricing Works: Spreads, Premiums and Discounts](https://p2pxbt.com/blog/how-p2p-pricing-works): Why P2P prices sit above or below spot, what a spread actually pays for, and how competing counterparties produce a range rather than one number
- [Choosing a Payment Method for P2P Trades](https://p2pxbt.com/blog/choosing-a-payment-method): Wire, ACH, Faster Payments, SEPA and FPS differ in ways that matter for P2P settlement

- [USDT vs USDC: Which Stablecoin Should You Use?](https://p2pxbt.com/blog/usdt-vs-usdc): A detailed comparison of USDT (Tether) and USDC (Circle) stablecoins, focusing on P2P trading liquidity, availability, and security

## Notes

- Trading requires identity verification approved by an operator. The platform
  does not support anonymous or no-KYC trading.
- Supported payment rails are bank transfers only. PayPal, Venmo, Zelle, Cash
  App and mobile-money rails are not supported.
- Coverage is limited to the United States, United Kingdom, the eurozone and
  Hong Kong. Other markets are not served.
